# `adt diagnose`

Runtime diagnostics (short dumps, traces)

```bash
adt diagnose [options] [command]
```

**Subcommands**

| Command               | Description                                            |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `adt diagnose dumps`  | List ABAP runtime short dumps or inspect a single dump |
| `adt diagnose traces` | List ABAP traces or inspect trace hitlist/DB accesses  |

## `adt diagnose dumps`

List ABAP runtime short dumps or inspect a single dump

```bash
adt diagnose dumps [options]
```

**Options**

| Option          | Description                    | Default |
| --------------- | ------------------------------ | ------- |
| `--id <id>`     | Short dump id                  |         |
| `--user <user>` | Filter by SAP user             |         |
| `--max <count>` | Maximum number of dump entries | `50`    |
| `--json`        | Output as JSON                 |         |

## `adt diagnose traces`

List ABAP traces or inspect trace hitlist/DB accesses

```bash
adt diagnose traces [options] [action]
```

**Arguments**

| Argument   | Description           | Default |
| ---------- | --------------------- | ------- |
| `[action]` | list \| hitlist \| db | `list`  |

**Options**

| Option      | Description                     | Default |
| ----------- | ------------------------------- | ------- |
| `--id <id>` | Trace id for hitlist/db actions |         |
| `--json`    | Output as JSON                  |         |

Global options (`--sid`, `--config`, `--verbose`, …) are accepted by every command — see the [command reference index](./index.md#global-options).
